issue.title: Record the project-pull-in-on-empty decision
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-74.1 note #1, bob-cli-74.2 note #1, bob-cli-74.4 note #1, bob-cli-74.5 note #1 and bob-cli-74.6 note #1 (all the same proposal). The bob-cli-74 epic's auto decision `decision_record` defaulted to no (no human reviewed the plan), so no memory was edited; every phase recorded the skipped record as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Small: one fully specified strand drawn from the approved plan's rollout step 5, not new design work. Related: bob-cli-63 (successor-links handoff decision record) — the new strand links to it only if it exists.

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add the decisions strand `project-pull-in-on-empty` once bob-cli-74 lands, mirroring existing decisions strands' frontmatter and sections:
- Applies to: bob-cli, bob-plugins, vault.
- Claim: a close gesture that empties a project, by `bob projects sync`'s own surface predicate (shared Rust helper src/native/projects/surface.rs; cycler mirror 089-successor-project.js), links its `^prj` at the closed task's anchor as Next and removes `#hide`; without an anchor (not planned today, disabled, cancelled) it only surfaces.
- Why: Bryan's 2026-10-12 request (quoted in plan:202610/project_pull_in_line_model.md Context) — be immediately aware when a project has no workable child tasks. Sync already surfaced emptied projects, but up to 15 minutes late and with no ledger slot.
- Rejected: ignoring Blocked residents; leaving `#hide`; linking on cancel; auto-releasing R when a task is added; reading child notes for sub-projects; the sub-project cascade.
- Cost: R stays Next after a new task until Alt+N; two engines; a <=15-minute Sub-projects marker staleness.
- Reopens when: pull-ins are routinely released unanswered.
- Evidence: plan:202610/project_pull_in_line_model.md, docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10/§12.11, bob-cli commits eb03584/5fc27f0/309e98a, bob-plugins 00f3e8f/9e05379 (plus the bob-cli-74 landing repair commits).
- Links: [[decisions/task-lanes-are-sticky]], [[decisions/projects-block-from-prj-line]], and [[decisions/closed-task-hands-slot-to-successors]] only if bob-cli-63 has written it.
Requires Bryan's authorization before editing memory, then `sase memory init`.

issue.creation_reason: Every bob-cli-74 phase proposed this decisions-web record, but the epic's auto decision skipped memory edits without human review; Bryan should decide whether to record it.
